create_car_racing_wrapper: create a CarRacingWrapper around a gym environment with grayscale, reward shaping, and early termination options
run_step_with_action_repeat: run the step method to execute repeated actions with reward shaping and sparse reward support
reset_environment_with_preprocessing: reset the environment and apply cropping, grayscale conversion, and frame stacking to observations
configure_observation_space: configure the observation space with optional cropping, grayscale, channel-first layout, and frame stacking
reset_to_specific_level: reset the environment to a specific level with preprocessing, frame stacking, and transposition applied
